# Cully v0.11.1

Patch for Team workspace handoff safety after membership changes.

- Removing a person from the team or project, or demoting them to viewer, returns their owned open tasks to ready so incomplete reviews and live claims are not stranded. Checkpoint and next step stay for handoff; evidence is cleared.
- `task_get` stale now matches inbox and reclaim at the exact lease expiry instant.

Upgrade: install the v0.11.1 CLI and redeploy MCP/data images at the matching tag. No new migration.
